title: Construction 3 exclusion from the completed D0 class
summary: Decide whether every bent function generated by Construction 3 lies outside the completed source-defined D0 class.

formal_statement.body: For every integer $k\ge2$ and every bent function $f:\mathbb F_2^{2k+4}\to\mathbb F_2$ generated by Construction 3 under its admissible field, basis, and mapping choices, prove $f\notin\mathcal D_0^{\#}$, or exhibit one admissible Construction 3 member in $\mathcal D_0^{\#}$.

scope.domain: Bent functions from AOFVS constructions and completed-class membership
assumptions: k >= 2 and the final input dimension is n = 2k + 4
f is generated by the source's Construction 3 under admissible field, basis, and mapping choices
The general source construction applies for k >= 3 and the source supplies the k = 2 boundary construction
D0# denotes the completed source-defined D0 class
parameters: Construction 3 field, basis, and mapping choices
scope.unresolved_remainder: Prove that every admissible Construction 3 bent function for every k >= 2 lies outside D0#, or exhibit one admissible Construction 3 member contained in D0#.

progress.summary: The source asks whether all bent functions produced by Construction 3 are excluded from the completed D0 class.
